posts.title: Rice blast spreading fast — what fungicide works best in August?
posts.body: My West Plains field has rice blast lesions spreading to about 15% of the crop. Applied carbendazim last season but it didn't work well. Anyone had success with tricyclazole 75WP this year?

posts.title: How I increased wheat yield by 22% using biostimulants — a 3-season case study
posts.body: Sharing results from our trial plots in Haryana using seaweed extract + humic acid. Breakdown of application timing, dosage, and observed gains across three varieties.

posts.title: Pink bollworm pressure unusually high this season — Gujarat farmers take note
posts.body: Trap counts in Saurashtra region at 12–15 per trap per week. That's 3× the economic threshold. Sharing scouting protocol and recommended IPM measures.

posts.title: My tomato farm hit ₹8.4L this season — here's what changed
posts.body: Switched to drip irrigation + soil moisture sensors + weekly soil testing. Sharing the exact schedule, input costs, and final P&L breakdown. Happy to answer questions.

posts.title: Yellow mosaic virus in moong dal — is there any resistant variety available?
posts.body: Lost about 30% of my crop to YMV this season. Whitefly vector population is very high. Is anyone using resistant varieties or bio-pesticides effectively?

posts.title: Complete guide to composting with farm waste — step by step
posts.body: Turn crop residue, kitchen waste, and animal manure into high-quality compost in 45 days. Covers C:N ratio, turning schedule, moisture management, and quality testing.
